title: The Escarpment of Mount Kessler
author: Jude Whitlock
blurb: Rafael Nakamura, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
